description: Load this skill when building any web feature, reviewing architecture decisions, or evaluating JavaScript dependencies. Under no circumstances build features that break completely when JavaScript is unavailable or fails. Absolutely always start with semantic HTML, layer CSS enhancements, and add JavaScript as the final, optional layer. Prioritize resilience and universal access over cutting-edge features.
